newsitem.title: USA: Three new FINEX cross rate futures start trade.
newsitem.headline: Three new FINEX cross rate futures start trade.

text.p: Trading began Friday in three new FINEX currency cross-rate futures contracts - the British pound/Swiss franc, British pound/Japanese yen and deutschemark/Spanish peseta.
FINEX is the financial products division of the New York Cotton Exchange.

Trading in the new contracts was launched with the opening of the European trading session at FINEX's Dublin trading facility and continued in the New York session, said FINEX vice president of marketing, Charles Minaar.
The move followed the April 3rd launch of the FINEX U.S dollar/South African rand futures contract.

"The pound/Swiss franc, pound/yen and mark/peseta contracts are considered cross-rate futures which allow traders to take a view on the relative position of the two non-U.S. currencies in a way which avoids U.S. dollar exposure," Minaar said.
FINEX will also shortly launch the following additional currency futures contracts: US dollar/Malaysian ringgit, US dollar/Singapore dollar, US dollar/Indonesian rupia, and US dollar/Thai baht.
